description: Which key encrypts the account's ink.resenha.privateEbook files. The key itself stays on the reader's devices; this record only names it, and keeps a copy locked with a recovery key when the reader saved one.

main.description: One per account. Written once, by the first device that makes a key, so two devices can't each make their own.

keyId.description: A fingerprint of the key, derived from it, that can't be used to find the key.

recovery.description: The key, encrypted with a recovery key that only the reader holds. Absent until the reader saves a recovery key.
